scenes.head: Before the plaster goes on
scenes.vo: In Nigeria, we build with block and plaster. The wires go into the wall, then the plaster goes on, and from that day, nobody can see them again. Not the owner, not the next electrician. Nobody.
Lagos Fire Service counted over one thousand six hundred fires in 2025, and electrical faults are the leading cause.

scenes.head: Fake copper, plastered over
scenes.vo: Some of it is fake cable: sold as copper, really coated iron. A fridge magnet, or a flame, will tell you.
Some of it is cable that's too thin for the breaker in front of it. And all of it gets plastered over.

scenes.tagline: A hands-free copilot for the electrician. Proof of every reading for the owner.
scenes.tag: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon · Indie track
scenes.vo: This is WireProof: a hands-free copilot for the electrician, on the phone already in their pocket, that keeps proof of every reading for the homeowner.

scenes.head: Start a job on the phone
scenes.sub: Name the house, tick the circuits; each one is sized by the rules
scenes.vo: An electrician starts a job on the phone in two minutes: the house, the owner's WhatsApp number, the circuits on the board.

scenes.head: Talk to it
scenes.sub: Muse Voice Transcribe hears Nigerian English; the copilot answers in a sentence, out loud
scenes.vo: Then they talk to it. Muse Voice Transcribe hears Nigerian English. The copilot answers in one sentence and says it out loud: two point five square millimetre cable on a ten amp type C breaker. And when it doesn't have the board yet, it says so instead of guessing.

scenes.head: A real board, in a real house
scenes.vo: This is a real board, in a real house.

scenes.head: Reading the board
scenes.sub: Muse Spark reads every device; code checks each rating, and asks when the print is ambiguous
scenes.vo: Muse Spark reads every breaker, left to right. Twenty-five, twenty, thirty, ten. A hundred-amp main. When one print is ambiguous it doesn't guess; it asks the electrician to check by eye. And it sees what isn't there: no RCD.

scenes.head: Reading a cable print
scenes.sub: The size must appear in the text the model copied, or the reading is refused
scenes.vo: Point it at a cable print and it reads the size off the sheath. The model doesn't get the final say: code checks the size is really in the text it copied, and refuses a reading it isn't sure of. On twenty-one real photos it read twenty right, and caught the one it got wrong.

scenes.head: Conduit in the wall, before plaster
scenes.vo: Before the plaster goes on, it photographs the wall.

scenes.head: Mapping the wall
scenes.sub: SAM 3.1 traces each run on the block grid; Muse Image shows the wall after plaster
scenes.vo: SAM 3.1 traces every conduit run, using the blocks as a ruler. This diagonal run fails: cables must run straight, so anyone drilling later knows where they are. Then Muse Image shows the wall after plaster, with the cables drawn where they really are. The owner keeps that picture.

scenes.head: The owner's report, on WhatsApp
scenes.sub: The verdict, the fixes in order, and the photo behind every one
scenes.vo: When the electrician signs off, the owner gets the report on WhatsApp. Not a certificate; a screening report. The verdict, the fixes in order, and behind every fix, the photo it came from. Every step is on the record, every rule is cited. The model reads; the code decides.

scenes.label: Built on Meta
scenes.head: Four Meta models do the work. Code makes every decision.

bullets.v: hears the electrician, in Nigerian English, hands-free.
reads boards and cable prints, and plans each step as the agent.
traces every conduit run in the wall, calibrated on the blocks.
shows the owner the wall after plaster, with the cables drawn in.
the privacy gate: blocks any photo with a face before it leaves the phone.

scenes.vo: Four Meta models do the work: Muse Voice Transcribe hears the electrician, Muse Spark reads and plans, SAM 3.1 maps the walls, Muse Image shows the wall after plaster. Muse Spark Open runs the privacy gate, so no photo with a face in it leaves the phone.
